description: This file defines a PHP class `Permission` within the namespace `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Error`. The class extends a system Controller and contains an `index()` method that sets up an error permission page, including loading language strings, setting page title, breadcrumbs, header, footer, and content views.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling permission errors in the admin error namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and renders the permission error page, including setting the title, breadcrumbs, header, footer, and main error view.
